name: Headless Mule
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Headless Mule, the strong headless mule of Brazilian folklore.
ANATOMY: ONE strong mule torso, exactly FOUR legs with iron horseshoes and ONE tail; neck ends smoothly with NO HEAD, NO ears, NO eyes, NO mouth and NO gore. [headless-mule-c03,headless-mule-c07,headless-mule-c11]
MOMENT: Gallop violently straight toward viewer, front iron-shod hooves striking stones, neck stump in silhouette.
POWER: No fire emitted because claims c05 locates it at nostrils/mouth conflicting with chosen headless form; ordinary sparks ONLY from iron shoes striking stone, no supernatural glow. [headless-mule-c03,headless-mule-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, subject fills80% of square; natural scale unless giant explicitly documented. Important features clear at200pixels.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant warm moonbreak/sunset or documented lantern, dramatic rim light, deep walnut shadows, natural moisture/dust.
SURFACE: tactile natural skin/fur/scales/wood where appropriate, opaque coarse textiles, rough stone, original visible painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Dark Brazilian parish road at night, no visible church inscriptions. [headless-mule-c08]
MOOD: dangerous for hostile beings, awe-inspiring and respectful for gods, guardians and living traditions, never cute/calm/decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text/lettering/logo/border/frame/watermark; no extra heads/limbs/fingers; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + neck-stump and two leg crops. Genuinely HEADLESS (mula sem cabeça, headless-mule-c01/c04/c07): the neck ends in a smooth, hollow, bloodless stump with no head, ears, eyes or muzzle. A strong equine body with one flowing tail and exactly four legs (one hind leg occluded in the charge — no extra or duplicated limb). Every hoof wears a clearly metallic iron horseshoe, the nearest striking stone and throwing real orange sparks (headless-mule-c03) in a violent night gallop with flying debris (headless-mule-c06/c08). Moonlit stone-walled rural path. The conflicting nostril/mouth-fire detail (c05) is correctly omitted because this variant is headless — a legitimate source-based choice. No gore, aura, text or borrowed design; imposing uncanny anatomy at 200px.
